records.prompt:

Input images 1-3 are visual references ONLY: preserve the same East Asian adult woman's face, age, skin tone, natural body proportions and black ponytail, plain white short-sleeve T shirt and dark charcoal long trousers. Scene: gray-blue seamless studio background and matching clear flat nonslip floor, soft photographic lighting and natural shadows. ONE simple firmly floor-fixed rehabilitation handrail runs horizontally behind the woman at waist height, with its two bolted posts visible, no moving chair. Clothing consistent. Bare feet, both fully visible.
Camera: fixed front slight three-quarter view, full body from head to all toes and handrail, natural perspective at waist level, portrait image, modest empty margins. She faces the camera almost squarely, torso upright and stable, knees comfortably shallow bent (about 15 degrees), pelvis level, feet parallel forward and about hip-width apart, both feet flat on floor. A wide continuous muted teal resistance loop is correctly wrapped around both lower thighs just ABOVE both knees at exactly the same height, with light initial tension. Her left hand gently contacts the fixed handrail on image-right, her other hand rests naturally near the waist. Feet and band are unobstructed. This is the START position; her body is near the center of the image with empty floor room to image-left for a later lateral step.
